# Open Library

> > Open Library is a free, open-access digital library offering 3M+ books with community-driven cataloging, borrowing, and reading discovery features.

Open Library provides universal access to books through digital lending powered by the Internet Archive's Controlled Digital Lending model. The platform combines a searchable catalog with community features like reading lists, subject browsing, and educational resources for students.

## Key Topics

- Digital books
- Free ebooks
- Book borrowing
- Controlled Digital Lending
- Open access
- Reading lists
- Subject discovery
- Account authentication
- Internet Archive
- DAISY format
- Book collections
- Community contributions
- Educational resources
- API access
- Open source

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to Open Library](https://openlibrary.org): Open Library homepage: free digital library catalog with 3M+ books
- [Sign Up to Open Library](https://openlibrary.org/account/create): Account registration page for Open Library access
- [Log In](https://openlibrary.org/account/books): User login page for accessing Open Library account and books
- [Help Center](https://openlibrary.org/help): Help center with FAQs, getting started guides, troubleshooting

## Book Discovery & Collections

- [Subjects](https://openlibrary.org/subjects): Subject directory for browsing Open Library books by categories
- [Curated Collections](https://openlibrary.org/collections): Curated book collections including awards, banned books, curricula
- [Trending Books](https://openlibrary.org/trending): Trending books page showing real-time community reading activity
- [Reading Lists](https://openlibrary.org/lists): User-created reading lists and book collections with export options

## Borrowing & Access

- [Borrowing Books Through Open Library](https://openlibrary.org/help/faq/borrow): FAQ guide on borrowing ebooks, checkout limits, and book holds
- [Add Books](https://openlibrary.org/books/add): Login page for adding books to Open Library catalog

## Educational Resources

- [Student Library](https://openlibrary.org/k-12): Student Library resource with K-12 educational materials

## Developer Resources

- [Developer Center](https://openlibrary.org/developers): Developer center with API docs, Web API, data dumps, open source

## Optional

- [Recent Changes](https://openlibrary.org/recentchanges): Activity log showing recent community edits and contributions
- [Random Book](https://openlibrary.org/random): Random book page from Open Library catalog
